chapter: Touring in the bus years and Jim Crow in the South
title: The colored hotel and Lee County's reputation
summary: At the next town, locals say Lee County is one of the worst in the state, citing a Black prisoner shot by deputies.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: (Side B of Tape 3 begins at this point.)

I think I mentioned before, but to be sure, a white fellow came along with his son, about eight or nine year old boy and I flagged him down and he turned around and I asked him if he could take us to the next town, I said could you carry us. I said I'll pay you, I'd like to know what you charge. He said I won't charge you anything but I'll pull you, so he hooked us on and I drove with him in his truck. Going along, he just said, I wonder when will these people wake up and be civilized.

So we went on and when I got to the town, he took us to a garage and we asked him where was a colored hotel and he was nice enough to tell us where that was, he let us put our luggage in his truck and carried us to the hotel and the guy told us we could have the bus the next morning, he'd be through with it, and I said to him, is this your son, I've got to

give him something and I pulled out a roll and had a bunch of ones on top and I said, what about letting me give your son something? He says--whatever the boy's name was--he said he's not--dad didn't charge him, but he's going to tip us for bringing him here and he's giving it to you, but now remember, I didn't charge him anything for bringing them up here, he's just tipping. So I went peeling off some ones and when I got to five, he said that's enough. And I handed it to the boy.
After we got around to the colored hotel and got to talking, they said it's good you all got away from there, he said it's one of the most terribile counties in the state.

He said one time they had--a negro had done something and they thought something was going to happen, so they decided they were going to move him to another town and so the deputies who were bringing him shot him and then
What year would that have been?
